folds.heading: ## Whole-UI reconciliation B130, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Full UDF1–UDF9/A–D, cost/migration/capability/section maps, Part2 references/libraries, multi-path follow-up, capture table and CG fold read. Preserve four alternatives and task-specific examples, not a new whole-shell decision. Authoring defaults or silence do not record Weibao accepting A’s exact six hubs, B’s Today start, C’s sparse palette or D’s desk. Current [VISION_DIGEST](../VISION_DIGEST.md) and [DESIGN functional direction](../../DESIGN.md#selective-2d-exploration-2026-11-01) govern independent panels, prose-first editorial work, functional housing and selective spatial views. The desktop/laptop class is already in scope; a deferred MacBook-size check is a historical capture gap, not permission to defer laptops generally.

Costs in sessions, file lengths and15-point scores are inferred old estimates. A renamed route does not by itself prove saved pin/layout/selection/keyboard compatibility or complete registry coverage. Twenty mock captures are not the complete Village/Tingen ×14/21 ×full/off matrix, all production content, contrast or readability. Lower mock controls/DOM reflect a subset of mounted content; they do not establish a native performance speedup. Existing richer shell is the baseline, not a blank slate. Current actual suppliers/commands, chosen task and data matter more than a minimum/fixed number of panels, verbs, pins or tooltip levels. Keep opportunities to learn multiple paths, branches and non-ladder systems; the old one-pathway-per-life statement is neither a universal rule nor a new accepted restriction.

The original CG fold is superseded in part by the capability owner’s later notes, independently fully reviewed in B104: CG3 used a loading/empty lead snapshot, CG6’s Settings rename was dropped by later user preference, CG7 changes concerned wording/styles rather than a new engine gate, and CG5 comparison wording was later resolved at its named scope. Do not relaunch these as fresh blanket defects. CG2’s observer filtering still needs exact selected-world evidence; hub grouping alone is insufficient. Waiting without an active earning job is not proof of missing money or an entitlement to invented work.

B120 separately reviewed the gap audit and actual away_bank source: banking/spending is wired; anchor_snapshots is an event-graph derivation rather than a player-state rewind store. A factual return summary needs its own retained changes/known due work; it does not automatically require wiring that anchor module. The CG9/unreachable dependency claim must not become a mandatory new gate. Existing palette/Find functionality is already acknowledged within this audit; new lookup verbs/causal uses need actual observer-safe producers, not just more tags.

Reference-game patterns and relayed library versions/licences are dated leads, not newly checked facts, current tool recommendations or adoption authority. No library/asset/text was imported and no source acquisition occurred. Mock strings, diagram variants, provider skins and automated action suggestions remain proposals; search results cannot execute an irreversible action merely because Enter is convenient. Current AD42 optional review and AD51 shared seams qualify old process gates; active foundation/UI writers retain their selected scope. No live shell, runtime, package, source/visual proof or priorities were changed by this review.
